description: This file defines the ProcessContainerization class within the WPEFramework::ProcessContainers namespace. The class manages a text string related to process containerization, providing methods to access its data and length, and includes constructors for initialization. It also prevents copying and assignment.

classes.name: ProcessContainerization
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a text string related to process containerization, providing accessors for data and length, with constructors and deleted copy/assignment operators.

methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal text string data.
